cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：新西兰
cards.example_en: My uncle lives in New Zealand near the sea.
cards.example_zh: 我叔叔住在新西兰靠近大海的地方。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：太平洋
cards.example_en: Huge waves in the Pacific delayed the cargo ship for days.
cards.example_zh: 太平洋上的巨浪把货船耽搁了好几天。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：小包；袋
cards.example_en: A packet of tea fell out of the shopping bag on the bus.
cards.example_zh: 在公交车上，一小袋茶叶从购物袋里掉了出来。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：父亲或母亲；家长
cards.example_en: Ask a parent to sign the form before Friday's museum visit.
cards.example_zh: 星期五参观博物馆之前，请一位家长在表格上签字。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: He lives by a simple philosophy: homework comes before play.
cards.example_zh: 他奉行一个简单的哲学：先完成作业再玩。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：英镑；磅

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: Some families pray together before the evening meal.
cards.example_zh: 有些家庭在晚饭前一起祈祷。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：自豪的
cards.example_en: My parents are proud of me.
cards.example_zh: 我的父母为我感到骄傲。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: We show respect by queueing calmly for the school bus.
cards.example_zh: 我们平静地排队等校车，以此表示尊重。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：根；根源
cards.example_en: A thick root has cracked the path beside the old tree.
cards.example_zh: 一条粗根把老树旁边的小路撑裂了。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：无礼的
cards.example_en: It is rude to talk with your mouth full of food.
cards.example_zh: 嘴里塞满食物时说话是无礼的。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：悲伤的
cards.example_en: A sad film left the whole family quiet after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 一部悲伤的电影让全家人晚饭后都安静下来。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: My younger sister borrowed my coat and lost a button.
cards.example_zh: 我妹妹借了我的外套，还弄丢了一颗扣子。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: Their only son started nursery after the summer.
cards.example_zh: 他们的独生子夏天过后上了幼儿园。
